title: GTA 6's First Trailer Is Full of Real Cars in Disguise 🏎️ #Shorts
description:
The Ferrari Testarossa, Porsche 911, Chevy Monte Carlo lowrider, Chevy Tahoe and Chevelle: real-life cars identified in GTA 6's first trailer. Rockstar uses made-up brand names in the game.

Source: Jalopnik, "These Are The Cars Of Grand Theft Auto VI And The Real-Life Models That Inspired Them" (car IDs). Footage: official Rockstar Games GTA VI Trailer 1.
GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
